disposition_reason: As, Cu, Zn, Cd and Pb were measured by ICP-OES in 104 canned carbonated soft drinks of ten trademarks, with means ± SE per trademark.

study.design: Market survey of 104 canned carbonated soft drinks of ten trademarks from ten regions of Turkey
study.market: collected in Ankara, Sakarya, Denizli, Burdur, Yozgat, Ordu, Van, Kilis, Bolu and Adana regions
study.method: Degassing 24 h, microwave HNO3 digestion (Mars 5), ICP-OES (Varian Vista-MPX)
lod: As 9.5 µg/l, Cu 0.45 µg/l, Zn 0.10 µg/l, Cd 0.32 µg/l, Pb 0.75 µg/l
study.qa: Repeatability only; no CRM or recovery reported
